julesThoughtProcess: I chose Teal (#4DB6AC) to evoke a sense of calming utility and everyday resilience. The story highlights a grounded, slice-of-life interaction between human workers and AIs, reflecting the 'grounded optimism' constraint where hard work meets quiet connection.
storyPanel: A neighborhood fusion-core mechanic who always keeps a spare canister of synth-caf for the local maintenance drones. They might complain about the grit in the gears, but their open garage door is a beacon of warmth in the neon-lit industrial zone.
